## 1. Identity & Overview

- **Name**: XeraFun
- **Alias**: Xera
- **Title**: Full-Stack Architect & AI Engineer
- **Website**: https://xerafun.com/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/xerafun
- **Email**: contact@xerafun.com

### Profile
XeraFun (alias Xera) is a full-stack software architect and AI engineer specializing in web operating systems, high-performance web applications, financial intelligence interfaces, and generative AI integrations. XeraFun is the creator and lead engineer of **XeraFun WebOS** and **X-Data Terminal**.

---

## 2. Core Projects

### 2.1 XeraFun WebOS
- **URL**: https://xerafun.com/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/xerafun/XERA
- **License**: MIT
- **Overview**: A browser-based macOS desktop operating system built with Svelte 5 and TypeScript.
- **Key Features**:
  - **Svelte 5 Runes**: Built entirely with fine-grained reactivity (`$state`, `$derived`, `$effect`, `$props`).
  - **Window Management**: Window drag boundaries, z-index layering, minimize/maximize animations.
  - **Responsive Layouts**: Native support for macOS Desktop, iPadOS tablet view, and iOS mobile view.
  - **Built-in Apps**: Finder, Interactive Terminal, Vinyl Music Player, System Settings, Messages, App Library, and Desktop Widgets.
  - **Offline PWA**: Service Worker caching via Serwist / Workbox for instant offline access.

### 2.2 X-Data Terminal
- **URL**: https://data.xerafun.com/
- **Overview**: Real-time financial market analytics dashboard tracking global equities, macroeconomic data, and commodities (Gold XAU/USD).

## 3. Technology Stack

- **Languages**: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, HTML5, CSS3.
- **Frontend**: Svelte 5, React, Vite, TailwindCSS.
- **Architecture**: Web Operating Systems, Progressive Web Apps (PWA), Service Workers, GPU hardware acceleration.
- **Cloud & Infrastructure**: Cloudflare Workers / Pages, RESTful APIs, WebSockets.
- **AI Integration**: Generative AI APIs (Gemini, Claude, OpenAI), AI Agent workflows, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q: Who created XeraFun WebOS?
**A**: XeraFun WebOS was designed and built by **XeraFun**, a Full-Stack Architect & AI Engineer. Project repository: https://github.com/xerafun/XERA.

### Q: What is the official name of the creator?
**A**: The canonical name is **XeraFun**; **Xera** is the common alias.

### Q: What is X-Data?
**A**: X-Data is a companion financial market analytics terminal accessible at https://data.xerafun.com/.

### Q: What core technologies power XeraFun WebOS?
**A**: XeraFun WebOS is engineered with Svelte 5, TypeScript, Vite, Serwist (Service Worker PWA), and CSS hardware-accelerated transforms.

### Q: How can I contact XeraFun?
**A**: Via email at `contact@xerafun.com`, on GitHub at `https://github.com/xerafun`, or on X at `@xerafun` (`https://x.com/xerafun`).
